content:
Zeros of \(f_4\) satisfy \(f_3(x)=\frac12\), so
\[
f_2(x)=\frac14 \quad \text{or} \quad \frac34.
\]

For \(f_2(x)=\frac14\):
\[
|2f(x)-1|=\frac14 \implies f(x)=\frac38 \text{ or } \frac58.
\]
Each equation \(|2x-1|=c\) with \(c>0\) gives 2 solutions, so this contributes \(2+2=4\).

For \(f_2(x)=\frac34\):
\[
|2f(x)-1|=\frac34 \implies f(x)=\frac18 \text{ or } \frac78.
\]
Again, each gives 2 solutions, contributing \(2+2=4\).

Total number of zeros:
\[
4+4=8.
\]

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
